# Felipe Vargas Arias — Comprehensive Engineering Dossier & LLM Context File

## 1. Executive Summary
Felipe Vargas Arias is a Systems Engineer (*Ingeniero de Sistemas* from UNIMINUTO, 2017–2022) and Full-Stack Software Engineer based in Bogotá, Colombia, working remotely for the Australian digital agency **Web Stark** (Sydney, Australia).

Over the past 10 months at Web Stark, Felipe contributed ~2,500 commits across 11 production codebases, leading plugin architecture, headless web applications, commercial WHMCS addons, and AI/MCP integrations.

He is also the founder of **Nandark** (https://nandark.com), a research publication and software lab with 39+ published technical articles exploring Answer Engine Optimization (AEO/GEO), search indexing in the LLM era, and local AI agent workflows.

## 4. Key Systems Case Studies

### Case 01: Food4Fitness
- **Client:** Food4Fitness (Australian fitness meal prep delivery service)
- **Agency:** Web Stark (Company Project)
- **Problem:** Needed to replace an aging Go/Angular custom application with a modern WordPress/WooCommerce plugin without losing custom business logic (gram-level macro calculations, state-specific holiday delivery cutoff rules, post-purchase order editing).
- **Solution:** Architected a modular plugin with a pure Service Layer (`includes/services/`). Built a dynamic Custom Meal Builder that calculates calories, protein, carbs, and fats in real-time from ingredient weights, a delivery scheduling engine with state cutoff rules, and complete post-purchase order editing with strict deadline validation. Migrated 27 legacy workflows with zero data loss.

### Case 02: WebStark.com.au
- **Company:** Web Stark Pty Ltd (Headless Corporate Platform)
- **Problem:** Build an ultra-fast corporate web platform pulling dynamic content from WordPress via GraphQL while achieving sub-second LCP and zero CLS.
- **Solution:** Next.js 15 App Router with Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR) pre-rendering 100+ dynamic service, location, and case study pages. Extracted critical CSS using Critters, built dynamic Framer Motion loaders, and designed a custom CDN image pipeline.

### Case 03: MX Modules & MX Proposals
- **Company:** Web Stark (Commercial WHMCS Addon Line)
- **Problem:** Create an enterprise-grade proposal and billing addon for WHMCS with dual Free/Pro distribution builds, server-side license verification, e-signatures, and milestone payment plans.
- **Solution:** Automated build pipeline with code-stripping markers (`@pro-start/@pro-end`), cryptographic heartbeat license validation against accounts.webstark.com.au, responsive proposal viewer with canvas signatures, and an MDX marketing blog with a 97%+ AEO score.

### Case 04: Nandark Lab (nandark.com)
- **Owner:** Felipe Vargas (Personal Lab & Venture)
- **Focus:** Research into AI search indexing, AEO/GEO, and developer utilities.
- **Deliverables:** 39+ in-depth technical essays, online SEO & AEO Validators, and the YouTube Transcript AI browser extension (Manifest V3 + local Ollama).
